title: Should hide pagination whenever having 1 page or no results
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**
Maybe a Bug

**Bug: What is the current behavior?**
There are 2 contexts:
- Having only one page: should not display pagination, it has no meaning.
- Don't have any results: when users click on a link which in the past it has some results, but currently it doesn't; or navigate to a menu with 0 items.

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?**
Should not display page nagivation.

**Bug: What browsers are impacted? Which versions?**
Chrome latest.

**What project are you opening an issue for?**
- react-instantsearch

**What is the version you are using? Always use the latest one before opening a bug issue.**
2.2.4

comments.body:
@vinhlh We are planing on adding a `cannotRefine` css class to any widget that has a state where nothing can be clicked that will refine the search (no more items available, pagination has one page, things like that).

What do you think?
Merged, will go live this week, we will do announcement on https://discourse.algolia.com/c/instantsearch
